description: This file contains functions for handling JSON data structures and configuring device interface parameters, LEDs, switches, and other hardware settings in a UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) context for OpenWrt firmware. It provides utility functions to set device models, network interfaces, switch ports, LEDs, and other system configurations, mainly for embedded network devices.

methods.name: json_select_array
methods.description: Selects a JSON array by key, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: json_select_object
methods.description: Selects a JSON object by key, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface
methods.description: Configures a network interface with specified options and protocol.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface_lan
methods.description: Configures the LAN interface with device and protocol.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface_wan
methods.description: Configures the WAN interface with device and protocol.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interfaces_lan_wan
methods.description: Configures both LAN and WAN interfaces.

methods.name: ucidef_set_bridge_mac
methods.description: Sets the MAC address for the bridge.

methods.name: ucidef_set_network_device_mac
methods.description: Sets MAC address for a network device.

methods.name: ucidef_set_network_device_path
methods.description: Sets the device path for a network device.

methods.name: _ucidef_finish_switch_roles
methods.description: Finalizes switch port roles and configurations.

methods.name: ucidef_add_switch
methods.description: Adds a switch with multiple ports and configurations.

methods.name: ucidef_add_switch_attr
methods.description: Adds an attribute to a switch.

methods.name: ucidef_add_switch_port_attr
methods.description: Adds an attribute to a switch port.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface_macaddr
methods.description: Sets the MAC address for a network interface.

methods.name: ucidef_set_label_macaddr
methods.description: Sets label MAC address in system configuration.

methods.name: ucidef_set_led_ataport
methods.description: Sets LED trigger for ATA port.

methods.name: _ucidef_set_led_common
methods.description: Helper to set common LED properties.

methods.name: ucidef_set_led_heartbeat
methods.description: Sets heartbeat trigger for an LED.

methods.name: _ucidef_set_led_timer
methods.description: Helper to set LED timer properties.

methods.name: board_config_update
methods.description: Initializes and loads the system configuration JSON, updating model ID and name if available.

methods.name: board_config_flush
methods.description: Dumps the current JSON configuration back to file.
